commissioning_interpretation.finding: The PHASE1_M1_V1_HOMEPAGE protocol captured exactly one durable minimized page (the 903hvac.com homepage). The deterministic M2 opportunity-economics detector requires BOTH a commercial-HVAC industry signal AND a public inbound-path signal in the captured evidence corpus to form a hypothesis; a single homepage capture did not carry both, so M2 truthfully returned INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
commissioning_interpretation.not_a_defect: M2_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is a valid owner-pre-accepted bounded-research terminal, not a repair trigger. The minimizer, robots, egress, and truth controls all functioned correctly.
commissioning_interpretation.conclusion: Homepage-only collection is too shallow for opportunity evaluation. A bounded, same-host, relevance-prioritized multi-page corpus is required before Slots 02-24. That successor protocol is PHASE1_M1_V2_BOUNDED_SITE_CRAWL, designed in docs/readiness/m6.7-deployment/phase1-m1-v2-bounded-site-crawl-design-2026-08-29.md.
